# Backlog Governance Instructions

The backlog must be reviewed before it is moved to GitHub or any delivery system.

## Mandatory Checks

Check for:

1. Missing BRS coverage
2. Duplicated capabilities, epics, or stories
3. Stories that are too large
4. Stories that are too vague
5. Stories that are too technical
6. Missing business rules
7. Missing exception flows
8. Missing NFRs
9. Missing integrations
10. Missing security, audit, reporting, or compliance requirements
11. Weak traceability
12. Unresolved open questions
13. Architecture constraints not reflected in backlog
14. Delivery dependencies not visible

## Readiness Decision

Use one of these decisions:

- Ready for GitHub backlog creation
- Needs minor fixes
- Needs major fixes
- Not ready

Do not mark the backlog ready if high-severity gaps remain.
